purpose: xg-stack, council C6: the selection plan, written before any simulation of the selection (xg-stack ticket 01)

population.rule: the non-penalty shots of results/xgd_a1_ensemble/oof.csv (the 328 training matches of the xg-vendor split plan), with the host folds of cache/folds_xgv_home5.csv
population.outcome: the index goal column (v1.2 index, xgpoc.paths.INDEX), read inside the held-out label seal, kept apart from the design; never an input
never: any shot or label of the 172 held-out matches (135 evaluation, 37 gate)

e3.replay: the frames are replayed with E3's ball-source rule; the replayed raw features must equal features.parquet exactly
e3.angle_wrap: min(θ, 2π - θ) on every angle column, after the replay check (C6)

never: this shot's own label type (both shot types become one kind at parse)
the index label, goal or visibility columns
soccernet_flags.team: the team of the shot's own annotation; when it is missing, not home or away, or ambiguous, every flag is 0 and sn_team_unknown is 1

preprocessing.fitted_on: the training rows only (outer training folds; inner training rows for the inner CV)
preprocessing.imputation: training mean, plus the missing indicator columns
preprocessing.spline: natural cubic, df columns, knots at the quantiles 0, 1/df, ..., 1 of the training rows
preprocessing.standardisation: every design column, training mean and standard deviation (ddof 0), scale 1 if constant
preprocessing.zero_variance: a linear input with population variance <= 0.0 is dropped before any fit

gbm.role: sensitivity, reported either way, never changes a claim or the recommendation

read_out.delta_ll: LL(arm) - LL(R), mean per-shot log-loss, out of fold, on the population
read_out.practical_candidate: a Holm-rejected arm with point ΔLL <= -0.002
also: the chosen C per arm and fold

1_provenance.pass: every check passes (columns, constant inputs, banned names, held-out, flag code)

2_synthetic_nulls.truth: y* ~ Bernoulli(p_R), R fitted on the real labels under the chosen model

4_positive.pass: mean recovered ΔLL of G in [-0.003, -0.001]
reported: the dist_angle plant at the same target
power of G and GS with Monte Carlo SE (not gated)

clustered_nulls.coverage: one-sided bound <= the procedure's expected ΔLL; wording allowed at >= 0.95 - 2 Monte Carlo SE

common.stop_rule: if the final control 4 fails: no real run and no further iteration; the report gives the power curve and the smallest detectable effect; a real run after that needs the owner's protocol amendment (C6 Q4)
common.gate: the real run starts only if every final control passes
disclosures: E3's configuration was chosen on 135 of the 172 held-out matches by StatsBomb position error, with no outcomes.
Stacking provenance: the training-fold z values come from models that saw the scored fold.

z_g_combo is the averaged pre-Platt logit of the G-combo ensemble; each member's epoch and temperature were chosen on its own scored fold, an outcome-dependent step (corrected by council C6; C5's wording named a Platt fit on all 7,062 labels, which acts on p_g_combo only).
The flag windows were shaped after the StatsBomb recall/precision check on the 135 matches.
The flags are research-only: a product needs an action spotter.
The A1 noise floor is not quoted: the stacker is deterministic.
C5's frozen design failed its positive control; this design was chosen by council C6 among pre-listed candidates on simulated outcomes only.
common.after_the_run: a practical candidate goes to the owner, with the recomputed power on the 172 matches and the caveat that E3 was tuned on 135 of them; a test is the owner's decision, nothing is tested otherwise

c5.outcome: control 4 failed (G recovered -0.00077 of a planted -0.002, power 0.105); no real run

b.description: parsimonious G: dist natural spline 3 df, angle linear (wrapped), one shot-location missing indicator, one no-ball indicator; C5's fixed penalty (C = 1 on every column)

c.description: C5's G columns; C chosen by inner match-grouped CV from the grid, z unpenalised in every arm

model.name: inner_cv
model.choice: inner match-grouped CV over the other four host folds, summed inner held-out log-loss, ties to the smaller C

model.name: inner_cv
model.choice: inner match-grouped CV over the other four host folds, summed inner held-out log-loss, ties to the smaller C

selection.truth: unpenalised logistic regression of the real labels on [1, z] over every shot
selection.criterion: G's Holm power averaged over the two plants; the highest wins
selection.ties: equal averages go to the simpler design, in the order ['b', 'c', 'bc']

readings: Column names. Every E3 column is named <name>@<offset> (t0 = @0, -400 ms = @-400). The sanitised shooter_by_goal and gk_dist_goal enter as shooter_by_net and gk_dist_net, because control 1 bans the fragment 'goal' in a design column name; the values are unchanged.

Missing indicators. dist, angle and shot_x are missing together, exactly where the sanitised shot_ok is 0, and share shot_missing; kp_instance_conf has kp_conf_missing; n_keypoints and n_players share frame_missing. Every indicator is checked to be 1 exactly where its columns are missing.

Angle wrap (C6). After the exact E3 replay check, every angle column becomes min(θ, 2π - θ), so a shot location behind the goal line no longer has an angle above π; the counts of changed shots per offset are in the population counts (angles_wrapped).

Zero-variance rule (C6). A linear input whose population variance over its non-missing values is 0 is dropped from the arm before any fit (label-free); the dropped columns are listed per arm and every remaining input is asserted non-constant (control 1). GS is G plus the S flags left by the rule.

ball_source one-hot. The levels are none, own and one per fallback frame of E3's source order for that offset: at t0 own, m400, m800; at -400 ms own, m800. (b) keeps ball_none@0 as its no-ball indicator; the other levels are quality covariates.

Spline. A natural cubic spline with df columns is the truncated-power basis of Hastie, Tibshirani & Friedman (eq. 5.4-5.5) on df + 1 knots at the quantiles 0, 1/df, ..., 1 of the training rows' non-missing values (R's ns(x, df)), linear beyond the boundary knots; a missing value is imputed with the training mean before the basis.
Standardisation is applied to every design column with the training rows' mean and population standard deviation; a constant column keeps scale 1.

Model. Every logistic fit is Newton's method on the summed log-loss + 0.5 Σ λ_j w_j² with an unpenalised intercept (λ = 1 / C), which equals sklearn's LogisticRegression(l2, C) (tested). FIXED is C5's C = 1 on every column, z included. INNER_CV leaves z unpenalised by λ_z = 0 in every arm (rather than an offset or a x100 rescaling) and chooses C from the grid inside each outer training fold: the inner folds are the other four host folds (match-grouped), each inner design is preprocessed on its own inner training rows, the summed inner held-out log-loss picks C (ties: the smaller C), and the arm is refitted on the whole outer training fold. R under INNER_CV is the unpenalised fit on z.

Q = G + the quality covariates of the C6 brief: shot_x, shot_from_ball, shooter_by_net, the keypoint instance confidence (with kp_conf_missing), n_keypoints and n_players (with frame_missing). Under (c) they are already in G, so Q equals G. Q is reported with its interval and one-sided bound only (no p-value).

ALL = GS + the quality covariates + every C5 G column (the other ball levels included) + the remaining E3 columns at t0 (sanitised geometry not in G with a <column>_missing indicator each, the sanitised flags not encoded elsewhere, the sanitation indicators and counts) + every G input and extra at -400 ms (dist and angle linear), after the zero-variance rule.
GBM inputs are the arm's raw inputs without the missing indicators (native NaN), z_g_combo first and monotone increasing; no spline, imputation or standardisation.

z_g_combo in results/xgd_a1_ensemble/oof.csv is the mean of logit(stored p) of the two G-combo models that held each shot out, before the ensemble's Platt step, which acts on p_g_combo only. Every arm refits its own intercept and slope on it.
Log-loss clips probabilities to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6]; the calibration slope and intercept are the logistic regression of y on logit(p) with C = 1e6 (xgpoc.eval.calibration.PlattScaler).

The one-sided 95% bound of every arm is the 5th percentile of the bootstrap ΔLL ('no improvement larger than |bound|', only where the clustered-null coverage allows the wording); the 95th percentile is reported beside it.
Category ΔLL intervals restrict the same 2,000 match draws to the category's shots; a shot whose defining E3 input is missing is neither inside nor outside an E3 category.
Control 2's Holm detectable rate is the share of replicates in which Holm over {G, GS} rejects at least one arm.
Control 3 runs the full read-out of the real run on the permuted labels; its criterion is the Holm rejections only.

Plants. dist: the E3 t0 distance standardised over the population, missing 0 (C5). dist_angle: (d - e) standardised, d as dist and e the wrapped E3 t0 angle standardised the same way, so farther and narrower shots score less through both inputs. β is the negative root of true ΔLL(β) = target (brentq on [-5, 0]); the β = 0 refit is the unpenalised logistic regression of p_β on [1, z] over the population.

Selection truth: (a, b) of the unpenalised logistic regression of the real labels on [1, z] over every shot, one truth for every candidate; each plant's 200 outcome vectors come from that plant's seed and are shared by the candidates (common random numbers). Equal averaged powers means equal to the replicate count; the tie goes to the simpler design, in the order (b), (c), (b)+(c).
Final truth: (a, b) is R fitted on the real labels of every shot under the chosen model (C5's rule).

Power is the share of replicates in which G is a Holm 'detectable improvement', with Monte Carlo SE sqrt(p(1 - p)/n). The oracle's power is the share in which the oracle's own one-sided p (the same match draws) is <= 0.05, unadjusted: the ceiling for any arm.

The power curve's -0.002 point is control 4's dist plant; -0.003 and -0.004 use their own seeds. The smallest detectable effect is the true ΔLL at which G's Holm power first reaches 0.8 along the grid, linearly interpolated; beyond -0.004 it is reported as not reached.

Clustered nulls: a match random intercept u_m ~ N(0, 0.25²), drawn per replicate from the same generator before the outcomes; 0.25 logit is fixed here, before any fit, as a generous match-level variation in finishing beyond the shot. The coverage of the one-sided bound is the share of replicates whose bound is <= the replicates' mean ΔLL of the arm (the procedure's expected ΔLL); the wording 'no improvement larger than |bound|' needs coverage >= 0.95 - 2 Monte Carlo SE. The coverage of 0 is reported beside it. Control 2's replicates give the same coverage without clustering. The estimand is the fitted arm's expected out-of-fold ΔLL, which is what the match bootstrap of one run can cover: under a null it is positive (the arm's estimation cost), so 'no improvement larger than |bound|' reads as a statement about the arm as fitted, not about the information in its inputs; the coverage of 0 says how often the same statement holds for the inputs' true value.

Thresholds this file adds where C6 names a report but no number, fixed before any simulation: the smallest detectable effect at power 0.8, the coverage floor 0.95 - 2 Monte Carlo SE, the match random-intercept SD 0.25 logit, 200 replicates per simulation.
